使用文本指令移动、旋转或重新构建照片中的对象

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的照片。您要编辑的图像。适用于：产品镜头·角色·室内设计·概念艺术

步骤 2. 描述更改。用简单的语言编写编辑内容。空间指令效果最好，例如“旋转椅子以显示前视图”、“将杯子移到桌子的左边缘”或“为男人添加翅膀”。

步骤 3. 点击运行并下载。模型读取场景并应用编辑。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。适用于：Photoshop · Figma · Canva · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（1920 x 1280 · 40 步 · CFG 4 · 固定种子）对于几乎每个人来说都是正确的起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 JoyAI Image Edit 根据空间文本指令编辑图像，JoyAI Image Edit 是 JD Open Source 的开放权重模型，JD Open Source 是 JD Open Source 的开源部门。京东。空间理解使其与众不同。该模型首先解析场景，计算出每个对象的位置以及它们之间的关系，然后将您的指令应用到正确的区域。这使得它在编辑大多数模型的摸索方面表现出色：旋转产品、在框架上滑动物体、改变相机角度以及从单个静止图像生成新视点，而场景的其余部分保持不变。它将 8B Qwen 3 VL 编码器与 16B 扩散变压器配对，总共 24B。您上传一张图片，描述更改，然后在大约 2 分钟内得到编辑结果。无需设置，无需连接节点。

适用对象：产品团队、设计师和视觉特效艺术家，他们希望在 ComfyUI 中进行基于指令的空间编辑，而无需从头开始连接节点。不适合：面部和身份工作或特写皮肤细节。使用 Qwen 图像编辑工作流程来完成这些工作，并在编辑涉及位置、角度或视点时使用 JoyAI。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您要编辑的图片。

  2. 描述变化，命名物体、方向、角度或距离，然后跑步。

  3. 下载编辑后的图像，为任何编辑器做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。这是一个 24B 模型，运行 40 个未经精炼的步骤，因此每次编辑大约需要 2 分钟。有几件事决定了结果。空间编辑要按字面意思进行：“将杯子向左移动 3 厘米”节拍“调整杯子”，因此命名对象、方向以及距离或角度。说出什么是固定的，什么是变化的。将步长保持在 25 或更高，因为低于 20 图像会变得柔和。如果编辑偏离了您的指令，请一次提高 CFG 一点。 JoyAI Image Edit 获得 Apache 2.0 许可，因此您的编辑成果可以用于商业用途，没有收入门槛，也没有地域限制。

使用案例

空间重新定位。移动、旋转镜头中的对象或调整其大小，而无需重新进行渲染或照片。

产品多视图。从清单和目录的单个参考图像生成产品的替代角度。

场景构成。在框架中添加或删除元素，例如在角色上放置翅膀或清除集合中的杂乱元素。

相机角度变化。将场景的视角从单个静止图像转移，无需重新拍摄即可产生新的视角。

o.en:
Move, rotate, or reframe objects in a photo with a text instruction

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your picture. The image you want edited. Works great with: product shots · characters · interiors · concept art

Step 2. Describe the change. Write the edit in plain language. Spatial instructions land the best, like "rotate the chair to show the front view," "move the cup to the left edge of the table," or "add wings to the man."

Step 3. Hit run and download. The model reads the scene and applies the edit. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Photoshop · Figma · Canva · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (1920 x 1280 · 40 steps · CFG 4 · fixed seed) are the right starting point for almost everyone.

Overview

This workflow edits an image from a spatial text instruction using JoyAI Image Edit, an open-weight model from JD Open Source, the open-source arm ofJD.com. Spatial understanding is what sets it apart. The model parses the scene first, works out where each object sits and how they relate, then applies your instruction to the right region. That makes it strong at edits most models fumble: rotating a product, sliding an object across the frame, changing the camera angle, and generating a new viewpoint from a single still, all while the rest of the scene holds. It pairs an 8B Qwen 3 VL encoder with a 16B diffusion transformer, 24B total. You upload a picture, describe the change, and get the edit back in about 2 minutes. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: product teams, designers, and VFX artists who want spatial, instruction-based editing in ComfyUI without wiring the nodes from scratch. Not for: face and identity work or close-up skin detail. Use a Qwen Image Edit workflow for those, and reach for JoyAI when the edit is about position, angle, or viewpoint.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload the picture you want to edit.

  2. Describe the change, naming the object, the direction, and the angle or distance, then run.

  3. Download the edited image, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. This is a 24B model running 40 undistilled steps, so each edit takes about 2 minutes. A few things decide the result. Be literal with spatial edits: "move the cup 3 centimetres to the left" beats "adjust the cup," so name the object, the direction, and the distance or angle. Say what stays fixed alongside what changes. Keep steps at 25 or higher, since below 20 the picture softens. If the edit drifts from your instruction, raise CFG one point at a time. JoyAI Image Edit is Apache 2.0 licensed, so your edits are yours to use commercially, with no revenue threshold and no territory limits.

Use Cases

Spatial Repositioning. Move, rotate, or resize an object in a shot without redoing the render or the photo.

Product Multi-View. Generate alternate angles of a product from a single reference image for listings and catalogs.

Scene Composition. Add or remove elements from a frame, like placing wings on a character or clearing clutter from a set.

Camera Angle Changes. Shift the perspective on a scene from a single still, producing a new viewpoint without reshooting.
